inference.title: A100 · SWA atom DiT block (ESMFold2 style: sliding window |i − j| ≤ 64, 3D RoPE, per-head RMS norm, SwiGLU 256) · inference · d 128, cond 128, 4 heads × 32, bf16

panels.label: one block, A samples with a conditioning per atom (mod per row of c); with one conditioning for the A samples (forward_hoisted) I1 runs on S rows instead of A S

kernels.name: adaLN modulation
code: a = rn(silu(c))                              # bf16
mod = a Wmodᵀ                                # fp32 [rows, 768], bf16 MMA, fp32 accumulate
shift_a | scale_a | gate_a | shift_f | scale_f | gate_f

kernels.name: RMS-adaLN, q | k | v | g projections, head RMS norm, RoPE
code: x = rn(rn(q · rstd) (1 + scale_a) + shift_a)
p = rn(x Wᵀ)      W = Wq | Wk | Wv | Wg
Q, K = rn(rope(rn(p · rstd_{head})));  V = p_{v};  G = p_{g}

kernels.name: window attention
code: s = q·kᵀ / √32  for |i − j| ≤ 64, i and j < seqused
o = softmax(s) v         # per sample and head, one pass over the window

kernels.name: gated out-projection, RMS-adaLN, SwiGLU FFN
code: q1 = q + gate_a · rn(rn(sigmoid(G) · O) Woᵀ)
y = rn(rn(q1 · rstd) (1 + scale_f) + shift_f)
h = rn(a sigmoid(a) b),   a | b = y Wuᵀ        # hidden 256
out = q1 + gate_f · rn(h Wdᵀ)

hbm.name: q, c, out, Q, K, V, G, O
mod (a conditioning per atom | one for the A samples)

training.title: A100 · SWA atom DiT block · training · d 128, cond 128, 4 heads × 32, bf16

panels.label: forward (the inference stages, saving the backward's operands: a, X, PQ, PK, q1, att, y, ffn, lse)

kernels.name: adaLN modulation
code: a = rn(silu(c));   mod = a Wmodᵀ              # fp32 [rows, 768]

kernels.name: RMS-adaLN, q | k | v | g, head RMS norm, RoPE
code: as I2;  also stores X = x and the pre-norm P_{q}, P_{k} (bf16)

kernels.name: window attention
code: as I3;  lse = ln Σ exp(s) per sample, head, query

kernels.name: out-projection, RMS-adaLN, SwiGLU FFN
code: as I4;  also stores q1, att = rn(gated Woᵀ), y, ffn = rn(h Wdᵀ)

panels.hbm_title: HBM (sizes at N = 3072 atoms, A = 48, a conditioning per atom)

hbm.name: q, c, out, a, Q, K, V, G, O, X, PQ, PK, q1, att, y, ffn

panels.label: backward (stage by stage in reverse; every row stage writes its columns of the modulation gradient once; the weight gradients are cuBLAS GEMMs)

kernels.name: FFN backward, gate
code: dffn = rn(dy · rn(gate_f));   d gate_f = dy · ffn
a | b = y Wuᵀ (recomputed);  h = rn(a sigmoid(a) b)
dh = dffn Wd;  da | db = swiglu′(a, b) · dh

kernels.name: FFN backward, input side + adaLN
code: dy′ = dab Wu;  x̂ = q1 · rstd
d scale_f = dy′ x̂;  d shift_f = dy′
dq1 = dy + rstd (dy′ (1 + scale_f) − x̂ mean(dy′ (1 + scale_f) x̂))

kernels.name: out-projection backward
code: datt = rn(dq1 rn(gate_a));  dgated = datt Wo;  d gate_a = dq1 att
dO = rn(dgated σ(G));  dG = rn(dgated O σ(G)(1 − σ(G)))
D = Σ_{head} dO · O                       # the attention backward's row term

kernels.name: window attention backward
code: p = exp(s − lse);  dp = dO·vᵀ;  ds = rn(p (dp − D))
dQ = scale · ds K;   dK = scale · dsᵀ Q;   dV = rn(p)ᵀ dO

kernels.name: q | k | v | g backward, RMS-adaLN backward
code: dP_{q,k} = rn(head_rms_bwd(P, unrope(dQ, dK)));  dP_{v,g} = dV, dG
dx = dP W;  d scale_a = dx x̂;  d shift_a = dx
dq = rn(dq1 + rstd (dx(1 + scale_a) − x̂ mean(dx(1 + scale_a) x̂)))
reads: q, PQ, PK, dQ, dK, dV, dG, dq1
mod cols 0 .. 255, cos, sin, Wqkv | Wg

kernels.name: weight gradients
code: dWqkv = dP_{qkv}ᵀ X;  dWg = dP_{g}ᵀ X;  dWo = dattᵀ gated
dWu = dabᵀ y;  dWd = [dffn]ᵀ h

kernels.name: modulation backward
code: dc = silu′(c) · rn(dmod Wmod);  dWmod = dmodᵀ a      # dmod fp32 as hi + lo bf16 terms
per-sample conditioning: one dmod row per row of c;  shared: summed over 16 samples in-kernel
